name: attention-list
title: Attention list
author: Eduardo Retana
description: A prioritized list of rows that need a decision, with chips, an empty state, and a loading skeleton.

meta.descriptionEs: Filas que piden una decisión, con fichas, estado vacío y esqueleto de carga.

api.name: items
api.description: Title, description, tone, chips, href or onSelect, and a menu.

api.name: max
api.description: Hides the rest behind Show N more.

api.name: loading / emptyLabel
api.description: Skeleton rows, or the caught-up copy.

api.name: layout
api.description: table reads item.cells. compact is a dot, a title, and a chevron. The default stays stack.

docs: Independent implementation of a common dashboard pattern. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite a primitive the host already has.
